title.narrative: Enhancing the opportunities of Labour Migrants and Local Communities in vulnerable conditions to integrate in Greater Abidjan, Côte d’Ivoire

description.narrative:
To carry out a two-phased four-year Action Research project which focuses on broadening the sphere of opportunities for labour migrants and their host communities living in conditions of vulnerability to integrate in Greater Abidjan in a more inclusive, sustainable and safer manner, thus enhancing social cohesion and reducing environmental impact, thanks to the implementation of informed public policies, institutional capacity building and scalable pilot interventions.
During Phase 1 primary and secondary data collection and an evidence-based spatial and socio-economic analysis will lead to the formulation of recommendations for interventions, targeting decision-makers at the various levels. Based on those recommendations, small scale, tangible and transformative pilot initiatives will be designed and implemented. During the last six months of Phase 1, preparations for upscaling those pilots during Phase 2 will take place, through partnerships building and co-funding by creating synergies with other on-going/planned initiatives displaying similar objectives.
Based on the recommendations from Phase 1 and some initial lessons learned from the pilot projects, Phase 2 will be used to increase the size and impact of interventions. By the end of this phase, best practices and lessons learned will be extracted and disseminated to policy makers and partners at national and regional levels to ensure sustainability and replicability of these initiatives beyond the four-year project period. Dissemination will take place through existing, adequate platforms including networks of cities, UCLG-Africa and other stakeholders of Western Africa, such as ECOWAS and WAEMU.
